text:
lina: quick sync — proposal: unpin runtime v3.4 for a 5% canary at 03:15 UTC but leave SDK pinned (v2.7). reason: runtime bugfix for kv-cache. small blast radius.

oscar: prefer two-step: dry-run (no traffic) + canary. keep auto-rollback enabled.

nora: gates: p95 < 380ms, 5xx < 0.3%, smoke-eval pass. If any breaching rule hits for 3m, rollback.

deploybot: I can run dry-run and post a gate report. sample: `/unpin runtime=v3.4 --cohort=dryrun --dry-run --gates=/etc/deploy/gates/rt-3.4-dry.yaml`

oscar: add tenant exclusion for payment processors (avoid noisy load). also require trace-sample check: token-drop spikes < 4 in 1m.

qa-bot: smoke eval queued for dry-run. will webhook results.

lina: on-call: @nora primary, @oscar backup. if rollback happens, deploybot should create a ticket and ping eng-releases.

oscar: promql snippets (short):
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_runtime_request_duration_seconds_bucket{runtime=\"v3.4\"}[5m])) by (le))
```

nora: ok locking schedule: dry-run 02:15 UTC, canary 03:15 UTC only if dry-run green. I'll approve gate file once oscar adds exclusions.

lina: thanks — will wait for dry-run report before sign-off.
